label: Received onset is given, from onset receipt and correlativity
description: Transcription (single application, invariant 16): the last step applies correlativity. With the onset reading in place of the present-tense reading, correlativity yields only that a received-esse thing is given being at a first moment of its presence (fa3e228b), which the existential inertialist grants (Control part 1). Each premise is needed in a checked interpretation (part 4, no receipt; part 5, standing receipt with no giving). It shows that correlativity is compatible with existential inertia: the difference between the two conclusions is exactly the difference between the present-tense and the onset reading. All premises stay OPEN. No premise is established.
